items.question: What ritual offerings must follow the presentation of bilva leaves and ash?
premises: An umbrella is to be offered in the prescribed manner.
The offering of the umbrella precedes the next action.
A pair of chowrie fans is to be offered afterward.
items.inference: After offering bilva leaves and ash, the officiant must offer an umbrella and then a pair of chowrie fans.
items.plain_english: Having thus offered the umbrella, one should then offer a pair of chowrie fans.
